description:
Here is a detailed description of the illustrative figure, "Stage 4: Structured Arbitration Protocol," designed to represent the methodology described:

**Overall Layout and Styling:**
The diagram will have an aspect ratio of 4:3 (1100 logical units wide by 825 logical units high) and a clean, bright white background. It will be a publication-quality academic data flow diagram with a professional, flat design, free from drop shadows, gradients, or 3D effects. All text will use a clear serif font (such as Georgia or Palatino). There will be no clip art, decorative icons, emoji, background patterns, or textures. All arrows will be straight, either vertical or horizontal, emphasizing clear data flow. All colors used will strictly adhere to the specified palette, described in natural language.

The general flow of information is from top-to-bottom, organized into four distinct horizontal tiers, with consistent spacing to enhance readability and visual modularity.

---

**Tier 1: Input - Initial Data (Top Center)**
*   **Component**: A softly rounded rectangle, positioned prominently at the top center of the diagram.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 450 logical units wide and 60 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: It will have a clean white fill and a 2px solid border in a gentle, light grey.
*   **Labels**:
    *   **Line 1**: "1,598 pairs with 3-rater judgments" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
    *   **Line 2**: "All pairs proceed to arbitration (not just disagreements)" (slightly smaller, italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).

**Connection: Downward Arrow 1**
*   A single, straight downward arrow connects the center bottom of the "Initial Data" box to the top center of the "Arbitration Protocol" box.
*   **Styling**: A 2px solid line in a deep, rich navy blue.

---

**Tier 2: Arbitration Protocol (Center-Top)**
*   **Component**: A prominent, softly rounded rectangle, centrally positioned below Tier 1. This box represents the core of the structured arbitration process.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 500 logical units wide and 130 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: The main body of the box will have a very pale, soft peach tint fill, with a 2px solid border in a vibrant, warm orange.
*   **Header Bar**: A distinct header bar spans the top of this box, approximately 25 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: Filled with the vibrant, warm orange color.
    *   **Label**: "Arbitration Protocol" (bold serif font, bright white text).
*   **Body Content**: The body of the box is clearly divided into two conceptual columns, containing descriptive text:
    *   **Left Column (Blind Masking)**:
        *   "Blind masking:" (bold serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "Raters shown as A, B, C" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "No vendor identity revealed" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
    *   **Right Column (Order Randomization)**:
        *   "Order randomization:" (bold serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "50% fixed presentation order" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "50% randomized (position bias check)" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
*   **Bottom Annotation**: Centered below the two columns within the box:
    *   "Each arbitrator sees: all 3 rater judgments + reasoning + original question pair" (smaller, italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).

**Connection: Downward Arrow Split**
*   A single, straight downward arrow originates from the bottom center of the "Arbitration Protocol" box.
*   **Styling**: A 2px solid line in a deep, rich navy blue.
*   This arrow then smoothly splits into three parallel, straight downward arrows, each leading to one of the "Arbitrator" boxes in Tier 3.

---

**Tier 3: Three Independent Arbitrators (Three Columns)**
This tier consists of three identical modules, arranged horizontally and separated by subtle dashed lines, maintaining consistent visual weight.

*   **Component Template**: Each arbitrator is represented by a softly rounded rectangle.
    *   **Dimensions**: Approximately 240 logical units wide and 120 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: The main body of each box will have a very light, soft sage green fill, with a 2px solid border in a deep forest green.
    *   **Header Bar**: Each box has a header bar, approximately 25 logical units high.
        *   **Styling**: Filled with the deep forest green.
        *   **Label**: (Specific to each arbitrator, bold serif font, bright white text).
    *   **Body Content**:
        *   Model identifier (smaller, italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "Select rater A, B, or C — or synthesize" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "Provide final barrier + feasibility + reasoning" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).

*   **Arbitrator 1 (Left)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 1: Anthropic"
    *   **Body Text**: "claude-opus-4-5"

*   **Arbitrator 2 (Center)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 2: OpenAI"
    *   **Body Text**: "gpt-5.2"

*   **Arbitrator 3 (Right)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 3: Google"
    *   **Body Text**: "gemini-3-pro"

*   **Separators**: Thin, 1px dashed vertical lines in a soft, light grey will visually separate the three arbitrator boxes, indicating logical boundaries without harsh division.

**Connection: Three Arrows Converging**
*   Three straight downward arrows originate from the bottom center of each of the "Arbitrator" boxes.
*   **Styling**: A 2px solid line in a deep, rich navy blue.
*   These three arrows converge smoothly into a single, straight downward arrow that leads to the top center of the "Post-Arbitration Results" box in Tier 4.

---

**Tier 4: Final Verdicts - Post-Arbitration Results (Bottom Center)**
*   **Component**: A softly rounded rectangle, centrally positioned at the bottom of the diagram, mirroring the width of the Arbitration Protocol box for visual balance.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 500 logical units wide and 160 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: The main body of the box will have a very light, soft sage green fill, with a 2px solid border in a deep forest green.
*   **Header Bar**: A distinct header bar spans the top of this box, approximately 30 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: Filled with the deep forest green.
    *   **Label**: "Post-Arbitration Results" (larger, bold serif font, bright white text).
*   **Body Content**: The body of the box is clearly divided into two conceptual columns:
    *   **Left Column (Agreement Improvement)**:
        *   "Feasibility κ: 0.537 → " **0.843** (serif font, deep charcoal grey text, with "0.843" in bold deep forest green to highlight improvement).
        *   "Barrier κ: 0.611 → 0.796" (serif font, deep charcoal grey text).
        *   "Binary κ: — → " **0.896** (serif font, deep charcoal grey text, with "0.896" in bold deep forest green to highlight improvement).
        *   "Both quality gates: " **PASSED** (bold serif font, deep forest green text, emphasizing a successful outcome).
    *   **Right Column (Output Artifacts)**:
        *   "→ final_verdicts.csv" (italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "→ arbitration_merged.csv" (italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "→ stage3_arbitration_metrics.json" (italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text).
        *   (Blank line for clear vertical spacing)
        *   "1,598 pairs with consensus verdicts" (bold serif font, deep charcoal grey text).

---

**Left Margin Annotation: Trust Architecture**
*   A prominent vertical bracket will be positioned along the left margin of the diagram.
*   **Styling**: The bracket will be in a vibrant, warm orange, with a 2px thickness. It will visually span vertically from the top edge of the "Arbitration Protocol" box (Tier 2) down to the bottom edge of the "Three Arbitrators" tier (Tier 3), clearly encompassing both stages as a single conceptual unit.
*   **Labels**: Text labels will be aligned to the right of this bracket, describing key aspects of the trust architecture, with clear vertical spacing between points:
    *   "Trust architecture" (bold serif font, vibrant, warm orange text).
